notes.title: Update 1.0.2 is live!
notes.notes: [h1]1.0.2 Shaaman Too Good (and moar)[/h1][h1]Overview[/h1][p]This patch focuses on balancing the game and fixing some minor bugs. Hopefully it speeds up the game a bit, improves the difficulty curve, and stops the Shaaman for getting over 700% tower damage buff![/p][p]We also made significant progress in squashing bugs related to earning progression of XP, Badges, and star progression.[/p][p][/p][p]For more details, you can read the [url="https://clear-whale-4dc.notion.site/1-0-2-Shaaman-Too-Good-and-moar-23f88105b4128032a94ce53bcd9b07e0" style="button"]full patch notes[/url][/p]

notes.title: Minor Update 1.0.1
notes.notes: [h1]1.0.1 Overview[/h1][p]While this patch focuses on various fixes, it also hopes to address some of our players' more vocal concerns.[/p][p][/p][p]For more details, you can read them [url="https://aavegotchi.notion.site/1-0-1-Release-Patch-23f88105b412803d9973f9599d882587"]here[/url][/p]
